meta.title: Fotis Oikonomou | Full-stack Engineer (React/TypeScript · PHP/Laravel)
meta.description: Full-stack engineer in Athens with 10 years building web and mobile applications. Responsible for two nationwide production systems in Greece; most recently built frontend modules for Lithuania's national tax portal.

hero.lede: I've been building web applications for about ten years: the first six mostly on the backend (Laravel, Yii, Joomla), the last four mostly on the frontend with React and TypeScript. In practice, that means I can take a feature from the database schema all the way to the button the user clicks, with no handoff.
hero.lede2: I've done both: been the only developer on a project and been one of twenty people on a team. What stays constant is that I think about the risks, technical and timeline, from the start and put them on the table early, so delivery holds no surprises.
hero.traceLabel: Decorative waveform that reacts to the pointer

about.title: About
about.currently: I hold a diploma in Byzantine music, and I'm building a classifier that listens to a hymn and works out which of the eight modes (echoi) it belongs to — Python and librosa for the analysis, React for the UI. It's the first project where my two fields of study genuinely need each other.
about.p1: I'm a full-stack engineer with about ten years in web and mobile applications — the first six mostly backend (Laravel, Yii, Joomla), the last four mostly React and TypeScript.
about.p2: For nearly four years I was responsible for two production systems running across all of Greece: the Hellenic Coast Guard's incident-tracking system, used by every Port Authority in the country, and Safe Water Sports, a water-safety app for iOS and Android with 50,000 users. I took them over with serious database problems; I stabilised them and from then on kept evolving them with new features, without them ever going down for their users.
about.p3: Most recently I worked in a large team, building frontend modules for SOLON, Lithuania's national tax portal.
about.p4: So I've done both: been the person who keeps a system running single-handedly, and one of many people on a large project. Either way, I think early about what could go wrong and raise it before it becomes a problem.
about.p5: Open to roles in Greece, remote, or relocation.
